title: CS daily scratchpad - Apr 12 2026
body:
2026-04-12 (Mon) - CS scratchpad

Top priorities for the day:
- Prep QBR for Acme Corp (Thu 2026-04-15 10:00 PT) — need updated usage highlights, cost savings summary, and roadmap ask list.
  - TODO: pull token usage by route (eng asked to export by EOD) — follow up with DataOps / Jordan if not in by 4/12 3pm.
  - TODO: finalize slide on performance improvements (latency down 12% after v2 rollout) — ask infra for a short blurb + chart.
  - Send draft agenda to customer (cc AE Jordan Lee) by 4/13 noon.

Renewals / commercial nudges:
- DataStream Inc — renewal due 2026-05-01 (annual).
  - Notes: usage up 42% YoY, but overage spikes last month. AE (Jordan) proposed 10% list increase + committed burst credits.
  - Action: prep PSR (usage + cost analysis) and 2 pricing scenarios (baseline, preferred). Aim to share 4/14.
  - Linked ticket: CS-412 (pricing follow-up).

Support follow-ups / escalations:
- Ticket #12487 (embed endpoint returning 503s for long requests) — customer reports intermittent failures since 4/10.
  - Status: triaged by SRE, reproducer captured, potential retry bug in gateway.
  - My ask: confirm ETA for patch and share mitigation steps with customer (suggested: shorter seq lengths, client retry logic).
  - If no ETA by 4/12 5pm, escalate to on-call lead.

- Ticket #12523 (fine-tuning pipeline stalled) — waiting for infra quota bump. Followed up with infra-sr team this morning.

QBR prep checklist (Acme Corp)
- [ ] Cover slide + agenda
- [ ] Usage + cost trends (monthly) — need last 6 months
- [ ] SLA report (incidents, MTTR) — SRE to confirm
- [ ] ROI / value stories (2 customer success wins)
- [ ] Roadmap ask & recommended models/quantization for cost savings
- [ ] Next steps / ask (renewal, adoption play)

Email drafts / snippets (to copy):
- Quick agenda for Acme QBR:
  "Hi Maria — attaching a short agenda for our QBR on Thu 4/15. We'll cover usage trends, recent performance work, and a proposed roadmap for next quarter. Please let me know if you'd like to add anything. — Sophie"

- Renewal nudging note to DataStream AE (Jordan):
  "Jordan — putting together two pricing scenarios for DataStream renewal. Can you confirm target discount band and any exec sponsor commitments? Will aim to share draft by Tue 4/14."

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Ask product for short blurb on "smart routing" improvements — could be good QBR value-add.
- Think about including a small demo (2-min) of console trace timeline to show reduced error bursts.
- Consider proposing a Dedicated pilot for Acme's higher-latency routes (they're sensitive). Need to run rough TCO and talk to solutions-eng.

Open questions / things to confirm:
- Who owns the slide with "cost per 1M tokens" breakdown? (Product or Growth?)
- Are there any new usage limits being rolled out next month that would affect DataStream? (ask product-ops)

Quick meeting list (today):
- 11:00 AM — Sync with Jordan (prep QBR items) — 30m (zoom)
- 2:00 PM — Support triage w/ SRE (ticket deep-dive) — 45m
- 4:30 PM — Weekly CS standup (round-robin updates) — 30m

General housekeeping:
- Add Acme deck to Drive under shared_drives/customer-success/Acme/QBR-Apr-2026 (ask AE to upload latest slides).
- Move any post-QBR follow-ups to JIRA (label: qbr-acme-2026).

Short-term tasks (by end of week):
- Send Acme agenda (4/13)
- Share DataStream pricing scenarios (4/14)
- Confirm SRE ETA for ticket #12487 (4/12)

Random notes / scratch lines (keep here until I transfer to Confluence where appropriate):
- Possible upsell: model monitoring subscription + 90-day eval for advanced traces
- Customer asked about private deployment timelines — need to check with private-deployments PM (Liam)

---
Created quick checklist to convert items into tickets after QBR. Keep this doc as the working scratchpad until 4/16 then archive.
